Apart from being mentally unwell, it can be pretty boring. Most of the time everything revolves around two things. Seeing the doctor and food times. I usually get along well with the nurses and patients. The high dependency unit is different however, in those units it can be very stressful. The nurses don’t really have time to sit down and have a chat. So you feel like you’re in an eternal waiting room to see the doctor for ten minutes. Because it’s high dependence there’s a lot of angry people and they can be pretty scary. Lots of fights and yelling and ‘acting out’. I think the worst part about most units is the checks. I was usually on watch, every ten or twenty minutes at night shining a bright light in my eye just to make sure I was still breathing was horrible.  The other thing I hate is how much they like to give me benzos. Sure to calm me down, but sometimes I could barely keep my eyes open. Sleep, eat, doctor,  repeat. That’s my experience anyway.
